answer: Lock stake in a relic vault for 60 days. The key splits into shares held by cedar witnesses, peers who sign only for clean behavior. Each epoch shares migrate to new witnesses, like shifting dunes, so no fixed cartel can form. Attesting needs a threshold of shares. Faking 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA for two months and forces fresh bribes to a random witness set each epoch, $200 per witness, bleeding $200,000 monthly with no guarantee. Like a desert caravan: the relic is the cargo, cedar waystations hold the map pieces, and shifting dunes stop bandits ambushing the same route twice.
